Only embed from YouTube, never re-upload. 'match' is a case-insensitive regex tested in build_exhaust.py against the car page name and the cleaned and original shop names of its systems (d['car'], d['fits'], d['raw']); one video per car page, first match wins, so put specific patterns first. 'makes' picks the video for /exhaust/<make>/ pages, 'brand' is shown on the main /exhaust/ catalog.
